headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 23, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up with several exciting matchups and roster moves. Here's a summary of the top news, injuries, and trades from around the league.

Top News
The Yankees fell to the Tigers in a 3-5 showdown, with Amed Rosario leading the Yankees' offense with a home run and two RBIs. Framber Valdez earned the win for the Tigers, pitching 6.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 1 earned run. The Royals took down the Rays in a thrilling 2-1 victory, with Michael Wacha earning the win after 7.0 strong innings. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with 1 hit and 1 RBI. The Rangers secured a narrow win over the Marlins, with a final score of 4-3. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs. The Nationals took down the Phillies 4-1, with Foster Griffin earning the win after 7.1 innings of work. Curtis Mead led the Phillies' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

Injuries and Availability Impact
The Rockies have placed right-handed pitcher Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026. The Marlins have transferred Josh Ekness from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right calf strain. Liam Hicks has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 20, 2026, with a low back strain. The Athletics have transferred Luis Severino from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. Jack Leiter has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, with a right ankle posterior impingement. Adley Rutschman has been placed on the 7-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, with a concussion. Blake Treinen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Isiah Kiner-Falefa has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, with left forearm inflammation.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Braves have acquired right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff in a trade with the Nationals. The Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Jayden Murray in a trade with the Astros. The Astros have traded right-handed pitcher Jayden Murray to the Cubs for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. The Diamondbacks have traded shortstop Luis Urías to the Blue Jays for cash. The Braves have traded right-handed pitcher Hunter Stratton to the Pirates for catcher Joey Bart. The Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Hunter Stratton in a trade with the Braves.
